# Choosing System Architecture

## Core principle

Select the simplest architecture that satisfies quality attributes, failure boundaries, extension needs, and operational constraints. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- a local implementation detail with no system trade-off
- an architecture decision already fixed by a confirmed constraint
